title: Vote on releasing Apache Iceberg 1.12.0 RC0
summary: Neelesh Salian proposed RC0 as Apache Iceberg 1.12.0. The replies were non-binding +1 votes with verification reports, plus three issues. Yuya Ebihara noted that 1.12.0 removed the old helper logic for partition statistics and the new logic needs the Hadoop-based Parquet client. Xuanwo and Gianluca Graziadei found third-party doc-site assets (a Bootstrap stylesheet and lottie-player.js) in the source archive without matching LICENSE entries, raised as follow-ups rather than blockers. Steven Wu flagged that PR #16765 changed `toString()` of geometry and geography types to always print the resolved CRS and algorithm; reading stays compatible but written strings change. Xin Huang offered a PR restoring the old output, while Szehon, Anoop, Huaxin and the release manager preferred keeping the change and documenting it as a behavior change. After the fix for the license issue (#18191) merged, the release manager announced a new RC with a new vote thread.

positions.stance: Votes +1 but notes that the new partition statistics read/write logic requires the Hadoop-based Parquet client, which may be a problem for downstream projects that prohibit such dependencies.
The source archive bundles a Bootstrap CSS file without the MIT permission notice or a root LICENSE entry; this should be fixed for the next release and is not a blocker.

lottie-player.js is also bundled without a license entry, and a pre-existing NoSuchMethodError occurs when reading variant columns with commons-lang3 older than 3.13; neither is a regression or blocker.
The geometry/geography `toString()` change is a behavior change the community should be aware of; he is fine with 1.12 keeping it because reads are compatible.
Prefers restoring the old `toString()` output while still serializing explicit CRS and algorithm (PR #18169), but will follow the community's preference.
Keep the `toString()` change in 1.12 and list it under behavior changes: it is clearer, matches the serialization spec and simplifies the UDF definition-id work.
Keeping the behavior change is reasonable, with the revert PR as a fallback if there are objections.
Keep the #16765 change and document it; old metadata still loads and equal Geography types now print the same, which the UDF work needs.

outcome.note: RC0 was not released: after the fix for the source-archive licensing issue (#18191) was merged, the release manager said a new RC would be cut and voted on in a new thread. Only non-binding +1 votes had been cast; no tally was posted.

why_it_matters: 1.12.0 RC0 was replaced by a new candidate over third-party license notices, and 1.12 keeps a geometry/geography type-string change that will be documented as a behavior change.
